result.reason: The redline appropriately extends both licences to Corio’s Affiliates and contractors and retains M&A assignment rights, but it does not make the fully paid-up licence in Section 2.2 irrevocable. Section 14.1 also continues to require consent where the successor is a direct competitor, so transferability to all M&A successors is not assured. The new CUSTOMER(S) definition is unrelated to the requested licence changes and could affect provisions elsewhere in the agreement, making the redline non-minimal and potentially altering unrelated commercial intent. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language deficiencies.
